Title: Alsi Panjeeri
Body (HTML):
Our Alsi Panjeeri is the winter staple of every Punjabi household – a fragrant, crumbly mix of roasted flaxseed (alsi), whole-wheat atta and pure desi ghee, generously loaded with almonds, cashews and melon seeds.

Each batch is slow-roasted by hand until the flour turns golden and nutty, then the freshly ground flaxseed is folded in so it keeps its gentle, toasty flavour. The result is a wholesome, energy-giving panjeeri that has been trusted for generations to keep the body warm and strong through the colder months.

How to enjoy

  • Eat a spoonful or two on its own as a morning boost
  • Stir into a glass of warm milk before bed
  • Sprinkle over porridge or yoghurt

Made in small batches with no palm oil, no artificial colours and no preservatives – just honest ingredients, the way Nani made it.

Title: Alsi Pinni (Flaxseed)
Body (HTML):
Our Alsi Pinni takes the goodness of flaxseed and shapes it into the classic hand-rolled pinni. Roasted flaxseed and whole-wheat atta are slow-cooked in pure desi ghee, sweetened with jaggery and packed with chopped almonds and cashews.

Flaxseed is naturally rich in fibre and plant-based omega-3, which is why alsi pinni have always been a favourite for winter mornings and for new mothers in Punjabi homes. Each pinni is pressed by hand while still warm so it holds together beautifully yet melts in the mouth.

How to enjoy

  • One pinni with a cup of masala chai or warm milk
  • A wholesome mid-morning or post-workout snack
  • A thoughtful gift for family during the festive season

Handmade in small batches – no palm oil, no artificial colours, no preservatives.

Title: Atta Pinni
Body (HTML):
Atta Pinni is where it all began – the original Punjabi pinni that generations of families have made together every winter. Whole-wheat atta is roasted low and slow in pure desi ghee until it turns a deep golden brown and fills the kitchen with that unmistakable nutty aroma.

We then add jaggery for a rounded, caramel-like sweetness and fold in plenty of chopped almonds and cashews before rolling each pinni by hand. Rich, comforting and wholesome, it tastes just like the pinni from Nani's steel tin.

How to enjoy

  • With a hot cup of chai on a cold morning
  • As an after-dinner treat
  • Shared with family and friends at festivals and celebrations

Handmade in small batches – no palm oil, no artificial colours, no preservatives.

Title: Badam Bites Pinni
Body (HTML):
Our Badam Bites Pinni are a love letter to the almond. Ground and chopped badam are roasted in pure desi ghee with whole-wheat flour, then lightly sweetened and rolled into perfectly sized bites.

Smaller than a classic pinni and richer in almonds, they are ideal when you want a little indulgence that is still nourishing. Title: Besan Pinni
Body (HTML):
Besan Pinni is pure, golden comfort. Fine gram flour (besan) is roasted patiently in pure desi ghee until it releases its sweet, toasty fragrance – the most important step, and one we never rush.

A touch of cardamom and a generous handful of almonds and cashews are folded in before each pinni is pressed by hand. The texture is soft and fudgy, melting slowly on the tongue, with that classic besan flavour Punjabi families have loved for generations.

How to enjoy

  • As a sweet treat with chai

  • As a gift for loved ones near and far

Title: Punjabi Pinni
Body (HTML):
Our signature Punjabi Pinni is the full, festive version of the classic – the one made for weddings, Lohri bonfires and family gatherings. Whole-wheat flour and urad dal flour are roasted together in pure desi ghee, then enriched with jaggery and a lavish mix of almonds, cashews, raisins, melon seeds and edible gum.

The urad dal gives it a deeper, earthier flavour and a wonderfully satisfying texture, while the dry fruits add crunch in every bite. It is hearty, warming and made exactly the way it has been made in Punjab for generations.

How to enjoy

  • One pinni with warm milk on a winter morning
  • As a hearty snack between meals
  • As the centrepiece of a festive sweet box

Title: Sugar-Free Pinni
Body (HTML):
Our Sugar-Free Pinni gives you all the warmth and tradition of a classic pinni with no added sugar or jaggery. Instead, we sweeten it naturally with soft dates and figs, which add a gentle, caramel sweetness and extra fibre.

Whole-wheat atta is slow-roasted in pure desi ghee, then combined with the date and fig paste and plenty of almonds, cashews and seeds before being rolled by hand. It is a wholesome choice for anyone cutting down on refined sugar who still wants a taste of home.

Please note: dates and figs contain natural sugars. If you are managing diabetes, please enjoy in moderation and seek advice from your healthcare professional.

How to enjoy

  • With a cup of unsweetened chai or coffee
  • As a mid-afternoon energy boost
  • As a thoughtful gift for health-conscious loved ones

Handmade in small batches – no palm oil, no artificial colours, no preservatives.
